metadata.description: Runtime-only role for Auditbeat/Filebeat shipping from soc-endpoint. Deliberately WITHOUT the index 'manage' privilege: with it, anyone who compromises the endpoint could DELETE the SOC's own evidence indices. Also without manage_ilm / manage_index_templates - index templates and ILM policies are installed once, by the elastic user, via 'beat setup --index-management' in endpoint/install-endpoint.sh.
